title: SUNLU FilaDryer SP2 Storage Box Set (No Heating Base), Storage Box + PLA+2.0 Black 1kg*2
body_html:
[2-in-1 Filament Dryer and Storage Box Combination] Is there any way to handle drying and storage filament at the same time? SUNLU FilaDryer SP2, with efficient heating base and storage box, designed as two separated parts. Multiple storage boxes can be used as storage boxes can be freely stacked (maximum stacking of 3 is recommended) to enhance space utilization.
[Strong Sealing] The top cover and sealing bottom cover are designed with silicone, which has a good sealing effect. Whether used as a filament dryer or as a storage box, it has very good thermal insulation. When used as a storage box, it has been measured that under an average ambient humidity of about 50%, an average of about 25% humidity can be maintained inside.
[Large Internal Space and Spool Compatibility] Internal compatibility with 0.25~3kg spools, even paper spool can also be realized by fixing the spool roller. The storage box  compartment can hold two rolls of 1kg filaments, one roll of 2kg (2 rolls of 2kg filaments for SUNLU), and 3kg filaments, and supports a maximum spool diameter of 250mm and a maximum spool width of 153mm. it is compatible with both 1.75mm and 2.85mm diameter filament. Even damaged spools can be fixed with the spool roller.
[Humanized Design] The storage box part adopts the detail design of carrying handle + bottom depression, which is convenient for users to move. In addition, the storage box is equipped with an independent hygrometer for real-time observation of internal humidity changes, and 3 cable outlet holes on each side of the box to meet the printing needs of different sizes of filaments.
[Strong Safety, Stress-free Use] The triple safety design of 200W PTC + fan heating, secondary temperature protection switch and software intelligent temperature control ensures the heating process is foolproof.

title: SUNLU PP 2.0 3D Printer Filament 0.8 kg/roll
body_html:
SUNLU PP 2.0 is a lightweight, low-density material optimized from PP, offering faster printing speeds and a more stable printing process. It is suitable for producing impact-resistant and chemically resistant parts.

Chemical Resistance. Printed parts withstand various common acids, alkalis, solvents and lubricants, resisting swelling or dissolution caused by chemical media. Widely applied to lab containers, chemical tooling, fluid pipe fittings and other components exposed to chemicals.

Improved Heat Resistance. Optimized polymer formula delivers an elevated heat deflection temperature. The printed parts resist softening and deformation during long-term service, meeting manufacturing requirements for high-temperature components, heat-resistant molds and constant-temperature test fixtures.

High Toughness. Balanced rigidity and toughness. Printed models endure bending and impact without brittle fracture. Perfect for latches, hinges, wear-resistant stressed fittings and improves service life of moving functional parts.

Lightweight. Lower material density significantly reduces the weight of printed parts with the same dimensions. It effectively cuts weight while maintaining basic structural strength. Ideal for self-weight-sensitive components such as RC aircraft parts, drone accessories, lightweight tooling and wearable devices.

Low Warpage. Optimized molding shrinkage greatly reduces the risk of warpage and distortion during printing. Large flat and wide-area models can be stably formed, minimizing print failures and dimensional deviations.

Food Contact Safe. The filament adopts compliant food-contact-grade raw materials with no harmful substances leaching out. With proper post-processing, it can be used to fabricate tableware, food molds, snack storage boxes and other food-related products.

title: 【発送準備中】FilaDC i10 除湿キャビネット
body_html:
【フィラメントを乾燥した状態で、しっかり保護し、いつでも印刷できる状態に】
FilaDC i10は、モレキュラーシーブ除湿・密閉収納・インテリジェント湿度管理を一台の大容量キャビネットに統合しています。連続加熱に頼ることなく、i10は空気中の水分を能動的に除去し、乾燥剤システムを自動で再生することで、長期にわたる省エネな乾燥保管を実現します。

【モレキュラーシーブ除湿】水分を能動的に除去し、フィラメントを乾燥状態に保つ
モレキュラーシーブ除湿技術を採用したFilaDC i10は、高温加熱に頼ることなく、キャビネット内の湿気を継続的に低減します。密閉された庫内の空気から水分を捕集し、湿気に弱い素材のために乾燥・安定した保管環境を作り出します。
対応素材：PLA、PETG、ABS、TPU、ナイロン、PCなど、吸湿しやすいフィラメント全般に最適です。

【物理吸着 + スマートサイクル】自動で機能する乾燥保管
FilaDC i10は、吸着→再生→冷却→繰り返しというスマート除湿サイクルを採用しています。モレキュラーシーブが空気中の水分を吸着し、飽和状態になるとシステムは制御された加熱によって乾燥剤を自動的に再生、その後冷却してから再び除湿工程に戻ります。頻繁な乾燥剤の手動交換は不要、常時加熱も不要。必要なのは、途切れることのない湿度管理だけです。

【10巻収納 & スタッキング設計】フィラメントはもっと、散らかりはもっと少なく
標準フィラメントスプールを最大10巻、1台の密閉キャビネットに収納でき、専用の乾燥環境で整理整頓しながら保護できます。スタッキング可能な設計により、コレクションの増加に合わせて保管スペースを簡単に拡張できます。

【超低消費電力】高い電気代をかけずに乾燥保管
連続保管を前提に設計されたFilaDC i10の消費電力は、24時間あたりわずか0.23kWh。連続加熱に頼る従来の加熱式ドライボックスとは異なり、i10は吸着方式の除湿によって、大幅に低い消費電力で乾燥環境を維持します。フィラメントを24時間365日乾燥した状態に保つのに最適です。

【静音設計】作業スペースを邪魔しない、静かな乾燥
動作音30dB以下のFilaDC i10は、静かに背景で湿度を管理し、作業スペースの妨げになりません。印刷や作業、制作に快適な環境を保ちながら、フィラメントをしっかり保護します。

【インテリジェントタッチスクリーン操作】指先ひとつでシンプルに操作
直感的なタッチスクリーンインターフェースで、キャビネット内の環境を確認し、主要な設定を操作できます。
一目でわかるモニタリング・簡単操作・インテリジェントな運転。
庫内の状態を把握しながら、フィラメントの保管状況をしっかりコントロールできます。

【安全な連続運転のために設計】
複数のインテリジェント保護機構により、連続使用時にも安定した信頼性の高い動作を実現します。自動サイクル制御から温度・システム保護まで、FilaDC i10は長期的な乾燥保管をシンプルかつ安全に、そして安心して行えるよう設計されています。

【乾燥した状態で保管し、必要な時に印刷】
プリンターの稼働が止まっても、湿気の影響は止まりません。印刷と印刷の間も、フィラメントを密閉された管理環境の中で保管することで、外気の湿度にさらされる時間を減らし、素材の状態を安定して維持できます。スプールを取り出す。プリンターにセットする。印刷を開始する。フィラメントは常に保護された状態で、次の印刷にすぐ使えます。

【フィラメント保管だけではない】
FilaDC i10が生み出す低湿度の管理環境は、3Dプリント素材だけにとどまりません。電子機器、カメラ・光学機器、書類やコレクション品、粉末素材、そのほか湿気に弱いさまざまなアイテムの保護にもご活用いただけます……
湿気は、あるべき場所——庫外——へ。

title: SUNLU PLA Lightweight (LW-PLA) 3D Printer Filament 0.8KG
body_html:
SUNLU PLA Lightweight Filament is a low-density PLA material designed for lightweight 3D printed applications, especially RC aircraft and aeromodeling projects. It combines weight reduction, smooth printing performance, and refined surface quality to help makers create lightweight structures with excellent detail and reliability.

[Same Model, Less Weight] Compared with regular PLA, PLA-LW reduces the weight of the same model by approximately 30%. It delivers lighter models while providing more filament length per spool and enables makers to create larger lightweight models with more possibilities.

[Easy Printing & Reliable Results] Designed for easy and reliable printing, it works smoothly with standard PLA printing settings without complicated adjustments. Stable extrusion, clean layers, and consistent results make it easier to bring lightweight designs from the build plate to the finished model.

[Premium Matte Finish & Easy Painting] The printed surface features a natural matte texture with a refined finish, making details appear smoother and more professional. The paint-friendly surface allows colors to adhere easily, giving makers more freedom to customize aircraft models, crafts, and other high-aesthetic creations.

[Built for Versatility] From sky-bound RC aircraft to floating watercraft and lightweight outdoor gear, PLA-LW brings your high-flying ideas into reality—easier to print, lighter to hold, and better to perform.

PLA Metallic filament creates a realistic metal-like texture with a smooth surface and elegant shine, bringing your creative models, decorations, and display pieces closer to a premium metal aesthetic — without complicated post-processing. From artistic sculptures to functional designs, achieve a refined metallic look with the simplicity and reliability of PLA printing.

[Bring Artistic Elegance to Life with Radiant Metal Finishes]
PLA Metallic delivers a refined, smooth surface texture featuring subtle light-reflecting effects that highlight every line and detail of your prints. From classic vintage decor to sleek contemporary sculptures, easily achieve a sophisticated metallic look that adds warmth, elegance, and timeless charm to any display.

[Metallic Effect Powder, Realistic Metallic Look]
Special metal-like particles are integrated into the filament to create a distinctive metallic appearance. The printed surface features:

  • Natural metallic shine
  • Rich visual depth
  • Elegant texture details
  • Premium display quality

[Beauty Meets Better Performance]
Optimized material formulation brings stronger layer adhesion, improved toughness and dimensional stability for printed parts. Models resist warping and cracking with outstanding detail reproduction. Balancing visual texture and structural strength, it meets printing demands for creative figurines and functional components.

[Universal Compatibility & Reliable Extrusion]
Precision-manufactured to a standard 1.75mm diameter with strict tolerances, this filament ensures smooth, consistent feeding and tangle-free extrusion. It offers seamless plug-and-play performance across virtually all popular desktop FDM 3D printers on the market.

title: [Coming soon] FilaDC i10 Filament Dehumidifying Cabinet
body_html:
[Keep your filament dry, protected, and ready to print] FilaDC i10 combines molecular sieve dehumidification, sealed storage, and intelligent moisture control in one high-capacity cabinet. Instead of relying on continuous heating, i10 actively removes moisture from the air and automatically regenerates its desiccant system for long-term, energy-efficient dry storage.

[Molecular Sieve Dehumidification] Actively Remove Moisture. Keep Filament Dry. Built with molecular sieve dehumidification technology, FilaDC i10 continuously reduces moisture inside the cabinet without relying on high-temperature heating. The system captures moisture from the enclosed air, helping create a dry and stable storage environment for moisture-sensitive materials.
Perfect for: PLA, PETG, ABS, TPU, Nylon, PC and other moisture-sensitive filaments.

[Physical Adsorption + Smart Cycling] Dry Storage That Works Automatically. FilaDC i10 uses a smart dehumidification cycle: Adsorb → Regenerate → Cool → Repeat
The molecular sieve absorbs moisture from the air. When saturated, the system automatically regenerates the desiccant through controlled heating, then cools it down before returning to dehumidification. No frequent manual desiccant replacement. No constant heating. Just continuous humidity control.

[10-Spool Capacity & Stackable Design] More Filament. Less Clutter. Store up to 10 standard filament spools in one enclosed cabinet, keeping your materials organized and protected in a dedicated dry environment. The stackable design also makes it easier to expand your filament storage as your collection grows.

[Ultra-Low Energy Consumption] Dry Storage Without High Energy Costs. Designed for continuous storage, FilaDC i10 consumes only 0.23 kWh per 24 hours. Unlike traditional heated dry boxes that rely on continuous heating, i10 uses adsorption-based dehumidification to maintain a dry environment with significantly lower energy consumption. Ideal for keeping filament dry 24/7.

[Whisper-Quiet Operation] Dry Filament, Without disturbing Your Workspace. With operating noise below 30 dB, FilaDC i10 quietly manages moisture in the background without disrupting your workspace. Keep your filament protected while maintaining a comfortable environment for printing, working, or creating.

[Intelligent Touchscreen Control] Simple Control at Your Fingertips. Monitor the cabinet environment and control essential settings through the intuitive touchscreen interface. 
At-a-Glance Monitoring · Easy Control · Intelligent Operation. 
Know the conditions inside your cabinet and keep your filament storage under control.

[Built for Safe, Continuous Operation] Multiple intelligent protection mechanisms help maintain stable and reliable operation during continuous use. From automatic cycling to temperature and system protection, FilaDC i10 is designed to make long-term dry storage simple, safe, and worry-free.

[Store It Dry. Print It When You Need It] Moisture doesn't to stop when your printer does. Keep your filament inside a sealed, controlled environment between prints to reduce exposure to ambient humidity and help maintain consistent material condition. Take out a spool. Load your printer. Start printing. Your filament stays protected and ready for the next print.

[More Than Filament Storage] The controlled low-humidity environment of FilaDC i10 isn't limited to 3D printing materials. It can also be used to protect other moisture-sensitive items, such as: Electronics, Cameras & Optics, Documents & Collectibles, Powders & Materials, Other Moisture-Sensitive Items...
Keep moisture where it belongs — outside.

title: SUNLU FilaDryer S4 Pro, Dual-Zone Filament Dryer with Independent Temperature & Time Control, 85℃ Max Temperature, Drying & Annealing 2-in-1, Fits 4 × 1kg Filament Spools
body_html:
[Smarter Drying, Better Printing] The SUNLU FilaDryer S4 Pro is designed to help makers and professionals keep filaments dry, stable, and ready to print. With dual-zone independent control, automatic humidity management, and built-in annealing mode, it delivers a more efficient and flexible filament drying experience.

[Dual-Zone Control, More Flexibility] The SUNLU FilaDryer S4 Pro runs two different drying settings at the same time. Dry PLA / PETG in one chamber while conditioning PA / PC / PP in the other, or set separate programs for different materials to save time and boost productivity.

[Faster Heating, Faster Results] Reach 85°C / 185°F more quickly with upgraded heating and airflow circulation. This helps remove moisture more effectively, reduce stringing, and improve layer adhesion for smoother print performance.

[Built for Advanced Materials] Add professional annealing support to your 3D printing workflow. The built-in annealing mode helps improve strength, dimensional stability, and heat resistance, making it ideal for PA, PC, PP, and for printed parts made out of engineering materials with an annealing temperature of 85°C or less.

[Smart Humidity Management] Set your target RH range from 30% to 50% and let the dryer do the rest. The system automatically starts when internal humidity reaches the set level and stops at 25% RH, helping keep filaments protected and ready to print.

[One Dryer, Multiple Adaptations] Compatible with PLA, PETG, TPU, ABS, ASA, PA (Nylon), PC, and variants with carbon fiber or glass fiber fill, and more. A large-capacity design for 4 × 1kg spools makes it a reliable choice for home studios, workshops, and 3D printing farms.

Upgrade your 3D printing experience with the SUNLU Basic Filament Collection, designed to cover all your everyday printing needs — from beginner-friendly PLA to high-performance PLA+ 2.0 and durable PETG.

Whether you're creating functional parts, artistic models, or rapid prototypes, SUNLU offers a complete range of filaments that combine consistent quality, smooth extrusion, and excellent layer adhesion.

🔹 One Collection, Endless Possibilities

  • PLA – Easy to print, perfect for beginners and daily use
  • PLA+ – Stronger and tougher with improved durability
  • PLA+ 2.0 – Enhanced strength and impact resistance for functional prints
  • PETG – Durable, flexible, and moisture-resistant for real-world applications
  • PLA Matte – Smooth, low-gloss finish with reduced layer visibility
  • PLA Meta – Optimized for high-speed printing with precision and efficiency

🔹 Why Choose SUNLU Basic Filaments?

  • Stable Diameter & Precision (±0.02–0.03mm) for reliable prints
  • Clog-Free & Bubble-Free Extrusion for smooth performance
  • Wide Printer Compatibility – Works with most FDM 3D printers
  • Optimized for Speed & Quality – From standard to high-speed printing
  • Cost-Effective Performance – High quality at an unbeatable price per KG

From daily printing to advanced projects, SUNLU Basic Filaments deliver the perfect balance between performance, reliability, and affordability.

No more guesswork — just reliable, repeatable color creation.

Stable Printing, No Matter the Color

Unlike traditional resins where each color needs different exposure settings,

Stronger Prints with ABS-Like Toughness

Perfect for:

10× Higher Pigment Concentration

Designed for Creative & Functional Printing

Recommended Printing Settings

title: Large Spool(3KG, 5KG ) 3D Printer Filament Prime Deals [Ship to USA Only]
body_html:
[5KG Large Spool] All-in-one large spool for small businesses and users who need to print consistently. Continuous printing without pause, 5KG extra large size.

[3KG Large Filament Spool Diameter] With 3KG large spool, keep printing without replace filament. The size of the SUNLU filament spool is suitable for hanging on a lot of FDM 3D printers.

[1.75mm Diameter] Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, it's suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.

[PLA+ Recommend Settings] We recommend printing at a Nozzle/Extrusion temperature of 210°C - 235°C (410°F - 455°F) and Bed/Platform temperature of 55°C - 65°C (131°F - 149°F).

[PLA Recommend Settings] To achieve the best printing results with SUNLU PLA filament, we recommend printing at a nozzle temperature of 200-230°C, a bed temperature of 50-65°C, and a printing speed of 50-100mm/s.

[PETG Recommend Settings] We recommend printing the PETG filament at a nozzle temperature of 220-230°C, bed temperature of 60-70°C, and printing speed of 40-600mm/s.

[ABS Recommended Settings] Nozzle print temperature: 250-260℃, Print platform temperature: 80-100℃, Printing speed: 40-60mm/s, Retraction distance: 5mm, Retraction speed: 50mm/s. Compatible with most FDM 3D printers that can use a 1.75 mm 3D printer filament.

[Strong Compatibility] SUNLU 3D Filament is not only applicable to all SUNLU 3D printing products: FDM 3D Printer, 3D Printer Accessories, and Filament Dyer, but also applicable to almost all FDM 3D printers of other brands.

title: 250g Spool PLA, PLA+, PLA+2.0, PLA Meta Multicolor Filament Bundle, 250g*8 Rolls
body_html:
[The Perfect Companion for Young Creative Makers]Each set includes 8 vibrant 250g filament spools, giving young inventors plenty of material to experiment, explore ideas, and create freely—turning imagination into reality.

[Space-Saving & Easy to Store]Each mini spool is only one-quarter the size of a standard spool, keeping workspaces and storage areas neat, organized, and efficient—ideal for homes and classrooms.

[Creative Color Freedom, No Waste]Enjoy a versatile multi-color selection for small models and creative projects. Easily switch colors without the waste of large spools that often go unfinished.

[Stable Compatibility for Smooth Printing]With a precisely controlled diameter of 1.75mm ±0.02mm, the filament ensures smooth feeding and consistent extrusion for reliable printing results.

[Safe, Non-Toxic & Eco-Friendly]Made from plant-based materials, this filament emits minimal odor during printing and is non-toxic and safe for home and classroom use. The low shrinkage rate (0.1–0.3%) helps reduce warping and deformation, ensuring accurate dimensions. Eco-friendly manufacturing further minimizes environmental impact.

title: SUNLU PLA New Color Collection, Fluorescent & Transparent Series 1.75mm 1KG
body_html:
Discover a new spectrum of creativity with the SUNLU PLA New Color Collection. This series introduces a vibrant mix of Neon and Transparent PLA filaments designed to bring more visual impact and lighting effects to your 3D printing projects.

From bold fluorescent tones that make your models stand out to crystal-clear transparent colors that create stunning light diffusion, this collection opens up endless possibilities for creative printing, decoration, cosplay props, and artistic designs.

Engineered for smooth extrusion, strong layer adhesion, and stable performance, SUNLU PLA 1.75mm filament is easy to print and compatible with most FDM 3D printers. Whether you're exploring multi-color projects or building a unique color palette, this new series helps turn your ideas into eye-catching prints.

[SUNLU PLA 3D Printer Filament] PLA material is the perfect choice for 3D printing enthusiasts! SUNLU PLA filament is reliable, versatile, and easy to use. No clogs, bubbles, or tangles, its excellent layer adhesion ensures high-quality prints every time. Ideal for beginners and experienced users.

[Neatly Wound 3D Filament Spool] SUNLU's self-developed neat winding device ensures that the filament is easy to use, with a 100% neat rate that reduces the risk of tangles and jams, and provides a smoother and more efficient 3D printing experience.

[Recommend Settings] To achieve the best printing results with SUNLU PLA filament, we recommend: 50 -100mm/s, at ozzle temp 200-210℃, 100-200mm/s, at nozzle temp 210-240℃

[1.75 mm Accuracy PLA Filament] SUNLU 3D printer filament dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, making it suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.

Warning | Read before you buy:

  • PEEK filament is extremely difficult to print and intended for experienced users only. Please ensure you have prior experience with this material.
  • An industrial-grade 3D printer with a high-temperature hotend, heated chamber, and controlled environment is required.
  • Consumer-grade printers are not suitable and attempting to use them may cause equipment damage.
  • Proceed only after fully understanding the material’s requirements.

[High Performance Engineering Material]
SUNLU PEEK (Polyether Ether Ketone) filament stands at the top of the plastics pyramid, offering outstanding strength, thermal stability, and chemical resistance. Capable of continuous operation at 240°C and short-term exposure above 300°C, it’s ideal for industrial applications where other materials fail.

[Exceptional Mechanical Strength]
With a tensile strength of 100 MPa and flexural strength of 163 MPa, SUNLU PEEK delivers remarkable rigidity and toughness. It maintains stability under load, making it suitable for precision parts and heavy-duty mechanical components.

[Superior Thermal & Chemical Resistance]
Featuring a glass transition temperature of 143°C and a heat deflection temperature of 147°C, PEEK excels in high-temperature environments. Its exceptional chemical resistance ensures durability against acids, bases, and solvents — ideal for aerospace, automotive, and electronic parts.

[Self-Lubricating & Flame Retardant]
PEEK’s low friction coefficient minimizes wear and frictional heat, extending component lifespan. It also carries a V0 flame retardant rating, providing additional safety in high-heat, high-stress environments.

[Ideal Applications]

  • Aerospace and automotive components

  • Functional mechanical fixtures and jigs

  • Bearings, bushings, and friction parts

  • Medical and orthotic devices

  • Food-contact and chemical-resistant containers

[Optimized Printing Settings]

  • Nozzle Temperature: 390–420°C (high-temp nozzle required)

  • Chamber Temperature: 80–90°C (enclosed printer recommended)

  • Printing Speed: 30–60 mm/s

  • Bed Adhesion: Apply high-viscosity curing adhesive

  • Maintenance: Replace nozzle periodically to avoid carbonization and clogging

[Important Notes]

  1. PEEK printing requires a fully enclosed, high-temperature 3D printer.

  2. Ensure adequate ventilation during printing due to high processing temperatures.

  3. Regular maintenance of high-temp components is recommended for consistent performance.

Experience the power of industrial-grade PEEK — engineered for professionals who demand maximum strength, precision, and performance.

title: SUNLU AMS Heater, Upgraded your Bambu AMS, Enables Drying while Printing
body_html:
This SUNLU AMS Heater is compatible with the Bambu Lab AMS - Automatic Material System.

  • Please note that this product is optimized and upgraded exclusively for Bambu Lab's AMS (1st gen), 
    and is not compatible with Automatic Material Systems from other Brands.

  • Regarding the visibility of the lid, the entire lid is not fully transparent. There is a transparent area on the front of the lid that allows you to see the internal operation.

Drying and printing are performed simultaneously. This is a heater that can upgrade the upper cover of the AMS. Compared to the traditional printing process using the AMS, which requires drying before printing, the upgraded version allows for simultaneous printing and drying.

Unique Air Duct Design. The innovative airflow system directs heat to circulate precisely around the filament area, ensuring efficient drying while protecting the AMS feeding motor from high temperatures. This design may also cause slight temperature and humidity differences between electronic components.

High-efficiency heating with uniform temperature distribution, reaching 70°C within 20 minutes. The dual airflow design ensures even heat circulation, preventing localized overheating of materials and effectively reducing the risk of thermal deformation.

High compatibility: After upgrading to the AMS Heater, it supports stacked 16-color printing and saves space. Upgrades the heater for the AMS Generation 1 upper cover, seamlessly integrating with the Generation 1 seal strip and fully compatible with the Generation 1 seal preservation function.

Simple upgrade process: Loosen—disassemble—tighten, completed in just 2 minutes.

Intelligent humidity monitoring:  
① Humidity mode default heating temperature: 55°C—users can adjust and save the temperature.  
② Default operating time: 6 hours.  
③ After the countdown ends, the device does not shut down; it automatically starts heating when humidity rises to 50% and stops heating when humidity drops to 20%.  
④ In rH mode, users can adjust humidity (range: 25%–50%).  
After adjustment, the humidity automatically starts using this set value.

Safe and Reliable:
PTC heating. Dual-level protection with a temperature control switch. Software-based intelligent temperature control, real-time temperature monitoring, and automatic control of the heating system. Maximum drying temperature of 70°C. Alarms are triggered when the temperature exceeds the set value by 10°C, when the temperature fails to rise, or when the fan malfunctions. The device operates according to the set time and automatically shuts down when the time reaches zero.

Product dimensions 363mm × 278mm × 131mm (LWH)
Outer box dimensions 415mm × 316mm × 190mm
Product net weight 1.7KG
Temperature setting range 35°C–70°C
Humidity display range See display: 10%-90%
Time setting range 0-99H
Power input specifications AC 110V 60Hz or AC 220V 50Hz
Maximum operating current 2.2A@230V 4.15A@120V
Maximum operating power 390W
Standby power 0.6W
Rated power 220W

To ensure optimal first-layer adhesion, use a print surface specifically designed for PP materials. Apply PP glue, set the part fan to 10% only, and print in an enclosed chamber to minimize warping. To enhance adhesion between the print and the platform, it is recommended to add skirt structures around the print. To prevent deformation caused by PP material crystallization, avoid using dense and rectangular infill patterns.

[Mesmerizing Galaxy-Inspired Color-Shift]
Drawing inspiration from the beauty of the Milky Way, SUNLU PLA Galaxy filament combines a deep cosmic backdrop with sparkling starlight effects. Thanks to its ultrafine color-changing pearlescent powder (particle size <200µm), your 3D prints will reveal dynamic color shifts under different angles of light. The result is a dazzling, starry finish that makes every print look extraordinary and truly one-of-a-kind.

[Smooth, Clog-Free Printing Experience]
Say goodbye to printing interruptions. PLA Galaxy is engineered for consistent, stable extrusion, ensuring smooth filament flow throughout the printing process. With precise 1.75mm ±0.03mm wire diameter tolerance and a recommended nozzle size of ≥0.4mm, it reduces the risk of nozzle clogs and delivers a reliable printing experience even at speeds up to 250mm/s.

[Seamless Surface with Ultra-Fine Detail]
This filament is designed to minimize layer lines, giving your creations a refined, professional look straight off the print bed. The shimmering pearlescent finish enhances the smooth surface, making every curve, edge, and texture stand out with elegance and precision. Perfect for creators who value both beauty and quality.

[Endless Creative Applications]
From decorative ornaments and jewelry to cosplay props, fashion pieces, and artistic sculptures, PLA Galaxy opens up limitless possibilities for creative projects. Its eye-catching finish makes it ideal for showpieces, gifts, or anything designed to stand out. Whether you’re a hobbyist or a professional, this filament elevates your designs to the next level.

[Premium Strength & Durability]
Beyond its stunning looks, PLA Galaxy is also built for performance. With a tensile strength of 100MPa and flexural strength of 163Mpa, it produces prints that are both beautiful and resilient. Its heat deflection capability up to 176℃ adds stability, while the 100% bubble-free quality guarantees consistent results roll after roll.

title: SUNLU FilaDryer SP2, 2-in-1 Filament Dryer Combine with Storage Box, Compatible with spool size 1kg×2 or 2kg×1 or 3kg×1
body_html:
[2-in-1 Filament Dryer and Storage Box Combination] Is there any way to handle drying and storage filament at the same time? SUNLU FilaDryer SP2, with efficient heating base and storage box, designed as two separated parts. Multiple storage boxes can be used as storage boxes can be freely stacked (maximum stacking of 3 is recommended) to enhance space utilization.
[Strong Sealing] The top cover and sealing bottom cover are designed with silicone, which has a good sealing effect. Whether used as a filament dryer or as a storage box, it has very good thermal insulation. When used as a storage box, it has been measured that under an average ambient humidity of about 50%, an average of about 25% humidity can be maintained inside.
[Large Internal Space and Spool Compatibility] Internal compatibility with 0.25~3kg spools, even paper spool can also be realized by fixing the spool roller. The storage box  compartment can hold two rolls of 1kg filaments, one roll of 2kg (2 rolls of 2kg filaments for SUNLU), and 3kg filaments, and supports a maximum spool diameter of 250mm and a maximum spool width of 153mm. it is compatible with both 1.75mm and 2.85mm diameter filament. Even damaged spools can be fixed with the spool roller.
[Humanized Design] The storage box part adopts the detail design of carrying handle + bottom depression, which is convenient for users to move. In addition, the storage box is equipped with an independent hygrometer for real-time observation of internal humidity changes, and 3 cable outlet holes on each side of the box to meet the printing needs of different sizes of filaments.
[Strong Safety, Stress-free Use] The triple safety design of 200W PTC + fan heating, secondary temperature protection switch and software intelligent temperature control ensures the heating process is foolproof.

title: [🎃 15%off Flash Sale] SUNLU PC-ABS 3D Printer Filament, High-performance 3D Filament 1KG
body_html:
[High performance PC filament] SUNLU PC-ABS Filament is a high-performance 3D printing material made from a polymer alloy of PC (polycarbonate) and ABS (acrylonitrile butadiene styrene). Combining excellent heat resistance and toughness of PC with the enhanced processing capabilities of ABS, printed parts remain stable even under high temperatures and impact. This material also offers a smooth surface finish and is highly compatible with metal coatings, making it ideal for applications that require both strength and aesthetic appeal. Widely used in automotive, electronics, and industrial sectors, PC-ABS delivers high-quality finished products and prototypes.

[SUNLU PC-ABS Print Settings] Nozzle temp: 260˚C ~ 280˚C, Bed temp: 100˚C ~ 110˚C, Chamber: 90˚C ~ 100˚C, Speed: 50mm/s ~ 230mm/s. Bed Surface: almost any surface with a thin coat of glue. Fan: Off.

[Colg Free & Consistent Diameter] SUNLU PC-ABS filament 1.75mm has good quality that would never cause clogs, jams, warps or other problems, has great bed adhesion, very consistent color and dimensional accuracy.

[Tough, Strong & Heat Resistant] SUNLU PC-ABS 1.75mm is one of the strongest and most heat-resistant of all SUNLU 3D filament materials available for printing on consumer-grade printers. Please note that PC-ABS is industrial engineering filament that need a high printing temperature and chamber Temperature(about 90˚C~100˚C), make sure of your printer's suitability before purchasing.

[Tips/Suggestions for Use]
* Calibrating your printer before printing is required. It is recommended to use an 3D Printer Enclosure when printing. For large part it is recommended to use a heated chamber. It is recommended to anneal the printed part right after the printing process to release the residual internal stress.
* Please ensure the filament tip must never be released during handling/storage to prevent irreversible node formation. Utilize the side holes on the spool for secure end-tip anchoring both before and after printing operations.

[Usage and Applications] SUNLU PC-ABS filament is quite budget-friendly compared to some carbon fiber-filled stuff. Its characteristics make it ideal for automotive interior parts such as dashboard, door handles or instrumental panel. SUNLU PC-ABS doesn't shrink much upon cooling and will withstand the temperatures in a black car, in the desert, in the summer time, with the sun shining.

title: [MOQ: 6KG] High Speed PLA+ 2.0(HSPLA Plus 2.0), High Speed 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[Breakthrough 600mm/s Ultra-Fast Printing]
Unleash unprecedented speed without compromising quality! SUNLU High Speed PLA+ 2.0 revolutionizes rapid prototyping and production, supporting blazing speeds of up to 600mm/s at 230–260°C. Engineered with advanced flow dynamics, it maintains flawless layer adhesion and surface finish even at extreme velocities—perfect for high-efficiency makers and industrial workflows.

[Filament Spool Diameter] Check the spool info

[Unbeatable Toughness & Impact Resistance]
Upgraded for rugged durability, HyperSpeed PLA+ 2.0 delivers 10x the strength of standard PLA, with enhanced flexibility to resist cracks, drops, and impacts. Ideal for functional parts, tools, or outdoor gear that demands both speed and resilience.

[Smooth Flow, Zero Clogs – Print Faster, Cleaner]
Optimized viscosity ensures bubble-free, jam-resistant extrusion at any speed. From intricate details at 50mm/s to lightning-fast 600mm/s builds, enjoy consistent flow, minimal stringing, and crisp dimensional accuracy (±0.02mm).

[Wide Compatibility & Hassle-Free Winding]
Featuring SUNLU’s proprietary 100% Neatly Wound Spool Technology, this tangle-free filament fits almost all 1.75mm FDM printers. Spool dimensions (8" diameter, 2.5" width, 2.2" hub) allow easy mounting, while its low-warp formula works flawlessly with or without enclosures.

[Smart Settings for Speed & Precision]
Maximize performance with recommended temps:

  • Nozzle: 200–260°C (speed-optimized tiers:

    • 200–215°C: 50–150mm/s

    • 215–230°C: 150–300mm/s

    • 230–260°C: 300–600mm/s)

  • Bed: 55–65°C (no adhesive needed).

  1. Why Choose High Speed PLA+ 2.0?
    ✅ 600mm/s Certified – Redefine productivity limits
    ✅ Industrial-Grade Toughness – Survives drops, bends, and stress
    ✅ Foolproof Reliability – Clog/bubble/tangle/warp-free printing
    ✅ Vivid Colors & Precision – Bright hues, ±0.02mm accuracy
  1. Perfect for: Rapid prototyping, mass production batches, functional engineering parts, cosplay props, and high-speed creative projects.
    Compatible with: All SUNLU and third-party FDM printers, dryers, and accessories.
  2. Elevate your 3D printing game with SUNLU High Speed PLA+ 2.0—where speed, strength, and simplicity converge for unmatched print performance.

【High-Speed Printing Performance】Adapts to 50mm/s-600mm/s print speeds. Engineered for rapid printing without compromising quality, this high-speed matte pla filament allows you to produce more in less time. Achieve smoother, quicker prints with precision and reduced layer lines.

【Fantastic & Smooth Matte Finish】The SUNLU PLA matte filament finish is great and really helps to hide layer lines,bringing out other details of the print Prints smooth and has a beautiful matte finish.SUNLU nice PLA matte filament is achieved without compromising bed and layer adhesion, which results in beautiful and fairly strong PLA filament parts.Almost metallic finish and soft smooth finish.

【Neatly Wound Filament & No Odour】SUNLU has a professional production line with strict control of neatly lined up lines to avoid knots during printing.Completely mechanical wire winding and strict manual checks to ensure neat lines with few kinks, avoiding possible breaks.SUNLU PLA Matte filament is a biological material, purified from corn grain, eco-friendly, odourless and harmless to humans.

【High Precision +/- 0.02mm Tolerance PLA Matte filament】1.75mm PLA Matte 3D filament(Tolerance Level : ± 0.02mm).1KG 3d printer filament reel,perfect roundness and very tight diameter tolerance,approximately 330m of PLA Matte filament on each spool ease of use,minimal warping,no clogging,no bubbles.Increase your 3d printing objects delicacy.

【High fluidity,Less Stringing,Strong Layer Adhesion】Better flow of SUNLU no plugging premium 1.75mm PLA Matte filament.It has consistent diameter & roundness,less stringing and warping,strong layer adhesion.Article-free and impurity-free.No impurities,no clogged.
Recommended PLA Matte Filament Print setting:
50-150mm/s at print temp 190-210℃
150-300mm/s at print temp 210-230℃
300-600mm/s at print temp 230-260℃

【High Compatiblity & Vacuum Pack PLA Matte Filament】Compatible with 99% FDM 3D printers (with heated beds) and 3D pen.Vacuum packed neatly arranged SUNLU PLA Matte filament, provide better printing result.Environmental protection,1KG PLA Matte filament is made from starch raw materials derived from renewable plant resources.

body_html:
[5KG Large Spool] All-in-one large spool for small businesses and users who need to print consistently. Continuous printing without pause, 5KG extra large size.

[1.75mm Diameter] Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, it's suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.

[PLA+ Recommend Settings] We recommend printing at a Nozzle/Extrusion temperature of 210°C - 235°C (410°F - 455°F) and Bed/Platform temperature of 55°C - 65°C (131°F - 149°F).

[PLA Recommend Settings] To achieve the best printing results with SUNLU PLA filament, we recommend printing at a nozzle temperature of 200-230°C, a bed temperature of 50-65°C, and a printing speed of 50-100mm/s.

[PETG Recommend Settings] We recommend printing the PETG filament at a nozzle temperature of 220-230°C, bed temperature of 60-70°C, and printing speed of 40-600mm/s.

[ABS Recommended Settings] Nozzle print temperature: 250-260℃, Print platform temperature: 80-100℃, Printing speed: 40-60mm/s, Retraction distance: 5mm, Retraction speed: 50mm/s. Compatible with most FDM 3D printers that can use a 1.75 mm 3D printer filament.

[Strong Compatibility] SUNLU 3D Filament is not only applicable to all SUNLU 3D printing products: FDM 3D Printer, 3D Printer Accessories, and Filament Dyer, but also applicable to almost all FDM 3D printers of other brands.

body_html:
【3KG Large Filament Spool Diameter】With 3KG large spool, keep printing without replace filament. The size of the SUNLU filament spool is suitable for hanging on a lot of FDM 3D printers.

【SUNLU PLA 3D Printer Filament】PLA material is the perfect choice for 3D printing enthusiasts! SUNLU PLA filament is reliable, versatile, and easy to use. No clogs, bubbles, or tangles, its excellent layer adhesion ensures high-quality prints every time. Ideal for beginners and experienced users.

【Neatly Wound 3D Filament Spool】SUNLU's self-developed neat winding device ensures that the filament is easy to use, with a 100% neat rate that reduces the risk of tangles and jams, and provides a smoother and more efficient 3D printing experience.

【Recommend Settings】To achieve the best printing results with SUNLU PLA filament, we recommend printing at a nozzle temperature of 200-230°C, a bed temperature of 50-65°C, and a printing speed of 50-100mm/s.

【1.75 mm Accuracy PLA Filament】SUNLU 3D printer filament dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, making it suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.

[SUNLU FilaDryer E2] The newest pop-up in 2025, made for engineered materials, helps infinite creation, drying and annealing in one.

    [Superior and Efficient Annealing] Up to 110°C, it can anneal 99.99% of engineering materials on the market, allowing the materials to fulfill their potential and giving your model excellent properties such as extraordinary impact resistance and toughness. Suitable for such as ABS, ABS-CF, ASA, PC, flame retardant PC, PC-ABS, PC-PBT, CoPA, PA6-GF, PA6-CF, PA12-CF, PA612-CF, PA12 etc...

    [Fast and Efficient Drying] 500W PTC ultra-high heating power makes your creation a step faster. It takes only 20 minutes to heat up to 50℃ at room temperature and 30 minutes to heat up to 70℃! Temperature can reach up to 110℃ (high temperature drying needs to take into account the temperature resistance of the filament spool)

    [Excellent Airtightness, Super Insulation Effect] One-piece silicone plug over the line hole, the cover plate is equipped with sealing silicone strips, to isolate the outside water vapor into the chamber. The all-round dual-chamber design at the top, middle and bottom realizes the heating temperature exceeding 100°C. Combined with the innovative closure system, the annealing process is more perfect, solving the two needs of annealing and drying in one machine.

    [Extra Large Interior Space, Super Adaptability] The maximum compatible spool size is Φ250mm*153mm, which is suitable for most of the regular spools on the market. Tested, it can hold 2 reels of regular 1KG spools, 2 reel of regular 2KG spools or 1 reel of regular 3KG spools. (Note that the test spools are SUNLU spools, other brands of spools will have slight differences, but basically compatible, when using the need to pay attention to the size of the spool.)

    [Strong Compatibility, Adapts to 99% of the use scenarios] Can be applied to both engineering materials and conventional materials. Built-in preset filament settings, one click to apply the preset. The wire diameter is compatible with most of the materials on the market (Φ1.75mm, Φ2.85mm), and the Teflon tubing included with the product is Φ4*Φ3mm in size and 8cm*2 and 1m*2 in length.

    [Strong Safety, No More Worries] Intelligent protection system, two-level temperature control switch, over-temperature will be disconnected, cooling will be restored. Double-layer heat insulation, when the internal temperature is >100℃, the external touch temperature is only <60℃. Fireproof material grade

    [Inspire Engineering Material Potential] Annealing significantly enhances the impact resistance and durability of engineering materials, allowing you to unlock engineering-grade performance in every creation, which can be applied to: drone accessories, helmets, screws and nuts, blower pipes, etc. Models that need to withstand high-intensity impact and durability.

[Low Shrinkage & High Precision] Engineered to minimize shrinkage during curing, SUNLU ABS-Like Resin delivers high-precision prints with smooth surfaces. You can rely on this resin for accurate, detailed results, even for intricate designs.

[Multiple Colors & Broad Compatibility] Tested for optimal performance, SUNLU ABS-Like Resin is highly compatible with a variety of 4K and 8K DLP, SLA, and LCD 3D printers. Available in a range of colors, it's perfect for bringing all types of creative projects to life.

[Leak-Proof & Secure Packaging] Our resin comes in a leak-proof bottle with a sturdy cap to prevent spills, and is secured in a protective airbag during shipping. This ensures safe delivery without the worry of leaks or damage in transit.

[Defy Moisture, Print with Confidence] Say goodbye to spoiled spools! Easy PA arrives vacuum-sealed with desiccant and features enhanced formulation resistance to ambient humidity during printing and storage. Spend less time dehydrating and more time printing strong, bubble-free parts.

[Unbeatable Toughness & Impact Resistance] Craft exceptionally strong, durable parts with SUNLU Easy PA filament. Engineered from PA6/66 copolymer, it delivers outstanding mechanical strength and superior impact resistance, making your prints remarkably tough, resistant to drops, and built to last.

[Optimized Printability & 100% Bubble-Free] Enjoy smooth extrusion and consistent quality thanks to precise 1.75mm diameter (±0.03mm tolerance) and guaranteed 100% bubble-free formulation. Achieves reliable layer adhesion and flawless surface finish.

[Versatile Speed & Temperature Range] Print flexibly at speeds from 50mm/s to 150mm/s. Optimize your workflow: use 250-270°C for standard speeds (50-100mm/s) or boost to 270-280°C for high-speed printing (100-150mm/s). Requires a heated bed at 30-50°C with adhesive.

[High-Precision & Great Value] Get premium performance with 1kg spools providing approximately 350 meters of consistent, high-tolerance (±0.03mm) filament. The dense net weight (1kg) and gross weight (1.3kg) ensure you receive ample material for your demanding projects.

[UV Resistant & Vacuum Package] SUNLU Easy PA Nylon 3d printer filament 1.75mm features uv-resistance, no brittleness or fading. Vacuum packaging offers superior sealing to prevent moisture. Please put SUNLU Easy PA back into the vacuum bag after using, or use the filament dryer before printing

title: SUNLU Filament Connector FC01, Fusion Splicer, Weldable to 1.75mm PLA, ABS, PETG, PCL, PA and PC Filament
body_html:
[Zero Waste] SUNLU Filament Connector FC01 fully utilize leftover 3D printing filament, minimizing waste and saving costs. The fusion splicer reduces tail material waste and helps users save on new consumables. Achieve efficient printing projects with zero waste.

[Creative DIY, Multi-Color Printing] Easily fuse filaments of the same material but different colors. Create vibrant, personalized 3D prints, whether for multi-color models or gradient effects. Unleash your creativity and make every piece unique with SUNLU Filament Connector FC01.

[Quick and Accurate Heating] SUNLU Filament Connector FC01 rapidly heats up to 185°C in about 3 minutes, improving efficiency and saving time. Temperature accuracy within ±3°C ensures reliable and consistent operation for a stable and efficient experience.

[Wide Material Compatibility] SUNLU Filament Connector FC01 supports up to 240°C, compatible with various 3D printing materials such as PLA, ABS, and PETG (1.75mm diameter). Enjoy excellent fusing performance regardless of the material used.

[Safe Design] SUNLU Filament Connector FC01 advanced temperature control and high-quality insulation materials keep the external temperature between 50-100°C during fusion, ensuring safe and worry-free use.

[Easy Operation] User-friendly design with a simple, intuitive interface (Power adapter not included. Use at least a 5V 2A adapter to avoid power-on issues). Select the appropriate settings based on the filament type, and follow detailed instructions and video tutorials. Perfect for beginners, with no complicated adjustments needed. Fusion completes in 10-15 seconds. (In order to guarantee a good connection, it is recommended to dry the filament before bonding to ensure that the filaments are not in a damp state.)

[Visual Operation] Built-in window and display screen for real-time monitoring of the fusion process. Provides real-time temperature information, ensuring users are informed of each step and the equipment's status.

[Efficient Welding, Excellent Results] Professional fusing technology ensures strong joints and smooth surfaces without affecting print quality. Produces models with smooth, seamless surfaces and stable performance during printing, ensuring high-quality results for both detailed and large components.

title: PLA Large Spool 3D Printer Filament 5KG
body_html:
[5KG Large Spool] All-in-one large spool for small businesses and users who need to print consistently. Continuous printing without pause, 5KG extra large size.

[SUNLU PLA 3D Printer Filament] PLA material is the perfect choice for 3D printing enthusiasts! SUNLU PLA filament is reliable, versatile, and easy to use. No clogs, bubbles, or tangles, its excellent layer adhesion ensures high-quality prints every time. Ideal for beginners and experienced users.

[Neatly Wound 3D Filament Spool] SUNLU's self-developed neat winding device ensures that the filament is easy to use, with a 100% neat rate that reduces the risk of tangles and jams, and provides a smoother and more efficient 3D printing experience.

[Recommend Settings] To achieve the best printing results with SUNLU PLA filament, we recommend printing at a nozzle temperature of 200-230°C, a bed temperature of 50-65°C, and a printing speed of 50-100mm/s.

[1.75 mm Accuracy PLA Filament] SUNLU 3D printer filament dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, making it suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.

title: ABS Large Spool 3D Printer Filament 5KG
body_html:
SUNLU ABS 3D filament is a type of strong and durable filament, ideal for printing durable items or functional parts that require higher heat resistance

[5KG Large Spool] All-in-one large spool for small businesses and users who need to print consistently. Continuous printing without pause, 5KG extra large size.

[Impact Resistance and Durable] ABS filament can withstand long-term use without being prone to wear or damage and is not prone to breakage or deformation when impacted or squeezed.

[Impact Strength and Toughness] ABS filament can withstand a certain amount of pressure without being easily deformed or broken, and can resist surface damage such as friction and scratches, allowing the product to remain intact in appearance even after long-term use.

[Recommended Print Setting] Nozzle print temperature: 250-260℃, Print platform temperature: 80-100℃, Printing speed: 40-60mm/s, Retraction distance: 5mm, Retraction speed: 50mm/s. Compatible with most FDM 3D printers that can use a 1.75 mm 3D printer filament.

[Diameter Tolerance ± 0.02 mm] SUNLU ABS 1.75 mm 3D printer filament is manufactured with high precision work and therefore has a tolerance of only +/- 0.02 mm. SUNLU has more than 10 years of production experience and has set strict standards for its products. A professional team controls all aspects of production to ensure the diameter and quality of 3D filament spools.

[Compatible with 99% 3D Printers] Compatible with most FDM 3D printers that can use 1.75mm 3D printer filament. The larger inner diameter of the filament spool makes unwinding easier.

[SUNLU Service and Warranty] SUNLU have a professional team for 3D printer filaments. If there is any problem with the 3D filament or any problem with the order or invoice, please let us know. We are always at your service.

title: PETG Large Spool 3D Printer Filament 5KG
body_html:
[5KG Large Spool] All-in-one large spool for small businesses and users who need to print consistently. Continuous printing without pause, 5KG extra large size.

[Excellent Layer Adhesion] PETG filament offers excellent layer adhesion, reducing the risks of warping and ensuring smooth, strong prints with great structural integrity.

[Enhanced Toughness] Known for its toughness, PETG outperforms many other filaments in durability, making it ideal for creating sturdy and resilient items that can withstand stress and use.

[High Impact Strength] With its high impact resistance, PETG is perfect for printing parts that need to endure bumps and drops, ensuring long-lasting performance without cracks or breaks.

[Robust Durability] PETG prints are robust and maintain their properties over time, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications where weather resistance is a necessity.

[Less Stringing & No Blocking] SUNLU PETG filament is specially engineered to reduce stringiness and eliminate clogging, ensuring a smooth and consistent print every time.

[PETG Recommend Settings] We recommend printing the PETG filament at a nozzle temperature of 220-230°C, bed temperature of 60-70°C, and printing speed of 40-600mm/s.

[Ultra-High 14K Precision]

Next-Level Detail for Professional Results

Powered by advanced 14K resolution formulation, SUNLU resin delivers incredibly fine details and sharp edges. Perfect for figurines, miniatures, and models that demand high-definition surface quality.

 Compared to standard 8K resins, details appear significantly sharper and more refined.

[Smooth Matte Finish]

Premium Look Straight Off the Printer

Enjoy a naturally smooth, matte texture that enhances realism and visual depth.
No excessive polishing needed — your prints already look display-ready.

✔ Ideal for:

  • Figurines
  • Display models
  • Artistic creations

[Low Shrinkage & High Stability]

Print with Confidence, Preserve Your Work

Designed with low volumetric shrinkage, ensuring:

  • Minimal warping or cracking
  • Long-term structural stability
  • Accurate dimensional output

Your prints stay intact even after post-curing and long-term storage.

[Excellent Flow & High Success Rate]

Smooth Printing, Fewer Failures

Optimized viscosity ensures fast resin flow and quick re-leveling between layers:

  • Cleaner surfaces
  • Reduced print defects
  • Higher success rate

Perfect for both beginners and professionals.

[Wide Compatibility]

Works with 99% of Resin Printers

Compatible with:

  • LCD Printers
  • DLP Printers
  • SLA Printers

No complicated setup — just pour and print.

[Low Odor, Better Printing Experience]

Comfortable & User-Friendly

Formulated with reduced odor for a more pleasant printing environment:

  • No harsh smell
  • More suitable for indoor use
  • Better user experience

title: [MOQ: 3KG] TPU 3D Printer Filament 1KG, TPU 90A/TPU 95A
body_html:
About TPU 90A / TPU 95A

“A” denotes the Shore A hardness scale, a standard unit for measuring material hardness specifically designed for softer elastic materials (such as rubber, TPU, etc.).

The numbers (90, 95) indicate the hardness value, with higher numbers denoting greater material hardness.

  • TPU 90A offers relatively softer material with superior elasticity, making it suitable for applications requiring high flexibility (e.g., phone cases, shoe soles).
  • TPU 95A features relatively harder material with slightly reduced elasticity, ideal for applications needing moderate hardness while maintaining flexibility (e.g., tool handles, seals, tires).

Material Properties

TPU 90A, Shore Hardness 90A - High Elasticity & Wear Resistance. 99.9% Antibacterial & Mold-Proof - Maintains Long-Term Hygiene. Superior Aging Resistance - Extended Service Life

  • Tensile Strength: 100Mpa
  • Flexural Strength: 163Mpa
  • Heat Deflection: 176℃

TPU 95A, High elasticity and resilience. Soft material (95A) with excellent flexibility and ductility

  • Elongation at Break: 1063%
  • Flexural Strength: 4.26Mpa
  • Tensile Strength: 34.4Mpa

Material: TPU Flexible Filament, TPU 90A/TPU 95A

Diameter format: 1.75 mm(±0.03 mm)

Printing temperature:

  • TPU 95A:
    190-210℃：50-80mm/s 
    210-230℃：80-120mm/s
  • TPU 90A: 220-240℃：≤40mm/s

Plate temperature: 50~60℃

title: [MOQ: 6Bottles] Water-wash ABS Like Resin 1000G
body_html:
SUNLU Water-wash ABS Like Resin, is a type of ABS-Like Resin which can wash by water.

[High toughness, good strength]
Printing model is not easy to brittle break, printing structural parts are not easy to deformation. Toughness is stronger than ordinary washed photosensitive resins, and is consistent with the performance of ABS-like resins.

[Can be cleaned with water]
Cleaning effect is better than ordinary water washing resin, details are more clear. Higher hydrophilicity and cleaner with water

[Low shrinkage, good fluidity]
Printing success rate is high, the print model does not crack, and save for a long time.

[Strong compatibility]
99% of LCD printers on the market can print easily.
Can also be used for DLP and SLA printers.

[No Pungent Odor]
No uncomfortable odor during the printing process.

title: [MOQ: 3KG] PLA-CF, PLA Carbon Fiber 3D Printer Filament 1KG, filled with 15% Carbon Fiber
body_html:
[SUNLU Carbon Fiber PLA Filament] SUNLU PLA-CF 3D printer filament is reinforced with 15% carbon fiber to increase the strength of PLA.

[Recommended Printing Temp/Nozzle Temp] 190-230°C (374-446°F), Base Plate Temperature: 60-80°C(140-176°F).

[Performance Advantages] PLA Carbon fiber filament has perfect dimensional stability for warp free printing, excellent layer adhesion, and easy support removal.

[High-quality Filament] SUNLU PLA-CF filament is reliable, versatile, and easy to use. No clogs, bubbles and tangles, its excellent layer adhesion ensures high-quality prints every time.

[Less Stringing & No Blocking] SUNLU PLA-CF filament is specially engineered to reduce stringiness and eliminate clogging, ensuring a smooth and consistent print every time.

[Frosted Matte Texture] Newly introduced carbon fiber PLA filament. Designed for matte effect printing. Ideal for creations that require a sophisticated and flawless look.

[Vacuum Packaging] SUNLU 3D printer filaments are vacuum packed with desiccant. Vacuum packaging avoids dust and moisture and can maximize the protection of filament from humidity.

[Wide Compatibility] SUNLU PLA filament has a diameter accuracy of +/-0.02mm, small diameter error, wide compatibility, and can be used on various common 3D printers.

#1 Beb's Repair Bench

title: SUNLU Multi-Color SILK Filament(Dual-color, Tri-color and Four-color) 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[Dual-Triple and Four-color Silk PLA Plus] SUNLU Multi Color Silk PLA Plus 3D Printer Filament offers a multi-color printing experience with 1 single filament. Printed creations with varying colors from different angles.

[Silky Texture, Smooth Finish] The Silk 3D filament delivers a silky, smooth texture with vibrant, eye-catching colors. Its dazzling surface requires no polishing, making every creation radiate artistic brilliance.

[Enhanced Toughness Silk PLA+] With 50 times the toughness of regular PLA, Silk PLA+ stands out for its flexibility without breaking, impact resistance without cracking, and excellent compression strength.

[Neatly Wound for Hassle-Free Printing] SUNLU’s 3D filament is precision machine-wound, ensuring tangle-free, organized printing. The 1.75 mm filament comes with a high level of accuracy at +/- 0.02 mm, offered in 1kg (2.2 lbs) spools.

[Reusable Vacuum-Sealed Storage] We provide full protection with durable packaging, reusable vacuum bags to block moisture, and dual desiccants. These safeguards keep your filament in perfect condition for both storage and use.

[Recommended Settings] For best results, use a nozzle temperature of 205°C - 215°C (401°F - 419°F) and a bed temperature of 50°C - 65°C (122°F - 149°F).

【Wide Compatibility】Works and harmonizes perfectly with all common 1.75mm FDM 3D printers, thanks to the high quality standards in terms of manufacturing accuracy and the small tolerance in diameter of +/- 0.03mm.

title: SUNLU TPU-SILK(SILK-Textured TPU) 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[Shore hardness 98A, combining flexibility with wear and scratch resistance] With a hardness of 98A, this material offers excellent flexibility while also providing strong wear and scratch resistance. It is ideal for printing functional parts and highly durable models.

[Silk-like glossy texture with fine details] The printed product features a natural silk-like gloss, with rich details that balance both aesthetics and professional quality, enhancing the overall visual effect of the model.

[1.75 ± 0.02 mm diameter tolerance, high printer compatibility] The filament diameter tolerance is strictly controlled to ensure smooth and consistent extrusion, improving print accuracy and surface quality, while also enhancing device compatibility.

Rigid and Flexible

  1. Speed recommendation
    Near-end extrusion: within 50MM/S with retraction, 60mm/s without retraction.
    Distal extrusion: within 20MM/S without pumping back, 30mm/s without pumping back.
  2. Slicing suggestions
    Pursuit of softness: no filling, wall thickness control at 0.8mm~1.2mm for best effect.
    Pursuit of elasticity and hardness: open filling to 5 ~ 15%, wall thickness greater than or equal to 1.2mm
  3. Flexible adjustment flexible supplies cooling curing time is slower, the larger the model size, the speed of the print can be increased in the recommended print speed of 10mm/s
  4. Flexible silk consumables are not suitable for printing some hollow and have too much overhanging structure of the model
  5. Not suitable for printing over the higher size models, the higher the size, the top structure will appear nozzle cuts, wobbling

title: E ABS(Easy ABS) 3D Printer Filament 1KG(p.s.: For New Refill Spool is 0.9kg)
body_html:
[Redefined ABS for Effortless Printing]
SUNLU E-ABS (Easy-ABS) stands as a smart evolution of traditional ABS, engineered to solve common printing headaches. By fine-tuning the ratio of Acrylonitrile, Butadiene, and Styrene, we’ve lowered the barrier to entry without sacrificing core performance. It offers the perfect balance of strength and processability, making high-strength printing accessible even on open-frame printers.

[Warp-Free & Dimensionally Stable]
Unlike standard ABS that shrinks and warps uncontrollably, SUNLU E-ABS features exceptionally low shrinkage. This ensures your prints adhere perfectly to the bed and maintain their shape as they cool. The result is a stress-free printing experience with zero cracking and perfect dimensional accuracy for functional parts.

[Open-Printer Friendly & Odourless]
Forget about expensive enclosures and toxic fumes. E-ABS is formulated to print beautifully in open environments with minimal warping. It emits a very low odor during printing, making it safe and comfortable for home, school, or office use without the need for external ventilation systems.

[Balanced Strength & Toughness]
Engineered for real-world applications, SUNLU E-ABS delivers robust mechanical properties. It combines high strength to withstand structural loads with good toughness to absorb impacts without shattering. This balance makes it ideal for durable tools, protective cases, and mechanical components.

[Moisture-Resistant & Hassle-Free]
Say goodbye to filament drying. SUNLU E-ABS exhibits excellent resistance to humidity, meaning it does not require pre-drying before printing. It is virtually unaffected by ambient moisture, ensuring a bubble-free print straight out of the bag and reducing preparation time.

[Ideal Applications]
  • Functional tools and assembly jigs
  • Electronic housings and brackets
  • Automotive interior parts (air vents, cup holders)
  • Durable toys and protective cases
  • DIY repairs and replacement parts
[Optimized Printing Settings]
  • Nozzle Temperature: 225–255°C
  • Bed Temperature: 60–70°C
  • Printing Speed: 50-200 mm/s
  • Cooling Fan: Turn on
[Important Notes]
  • While E-ABS prints well in open printers, using a cardboard box or enclosure for taller prints (>10cm) can further stabilize the temperature and improve success rates.
  • Always ensure your nozzle is clean, as E-ABS requires precise temperature control for optimal flow.

title: SUNLU ABS 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
SUNLU ABS 3D filament is a type of strong and durable filament, ideal for printing durable items or functional parts that require higher heat resistance

Recommended for Enclosed Printers, best used with an enclosed 3D printer to maintain consistent printing temperature and minimize warping for optimal results, like Bambulab P series, X series.

[Impact Resistance and Durable] ABS filament can withstand long-term use without being prone to wear or damage and is not prone to breakage or deformation when impacted or squeezed.

[Impact Strength and Toughness] ABS filament can withstand a certain amount of pressure without being easily deformed or broken and can resist surface damage such as friction and scratches, allowing the product to remain intact in appearance even after long-term use.

[Recommended Print Setting] Nozzle print temperature: 250-260℃, Print platform temperature: 80-100℃, Printing speed: 40-60mm/s, Retraction distance: 5mm, Retraction speed: 50mm/s. Compatible with most FDM 3D printers that can use a 1.75 mm 3D printer filament.

[Diameter Tolerance ± 0.02 mm] SUNLU ABS 1.75 mm 3D printer filament is manufactured with high precision work and therefore has a tolerance of only +/- 0.02 mm. SUNLU has more than 10 years of production experience and has set strict standards for its products. A professional team controls all aspects of production to ensure the diameter and quality of 3D filament spools.

[Compatible with 99% 3D Printers] Compatible with most FDM 3D printers that can use 1.75mm 3D printer filament. The larger inner diameter of the filament spool makes unwinding easier.

[SUNLU Service and Warranty] SUNLU has a professional team for 3D printer filaments. If there is any problem with the 3D filament or any problem with the order or invoice, please let us know. We are always at your service.

title: SUNLU PLA 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[SUNLU PLA 3D Printer Filament] PLA material is the perfect choice for 3D printing enthusiasts! SUNLU PLA filament is reliable, versatile, and easy to use. No clogs, bubbles, or tangles, its excellent layer adhesion ensures high-quality prints every time. Ideal for beginners and experienced users.

[Neatly Wound 3D Filament Spool] SUNLU's self-developed neat winding device ensures that the filament is easy to use, with a 100% neat rate that reduces the risk of tangles and jams, and provides a smoother and more efficient 3D printing experience.

[Recommend Settings] To achieve the best printing results with SUNLU PLA filament, we recommend: 50 -100mm/s, at ozzle temp 200-210℃, 100-200mm/s, at nozzle temp 210-240℃

[1.75 mm Accuracy PLA Filament] SUNLU 3D printer filament dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, making it suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.

[Filament Spool Diameter] Check the spool info

title: SUNLU ASA 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
SUNLU ASA 3D Filament: ASA filament is kind of very strong and tough filament, stronger than PLA filament and ABS filament. No clog, no bubble, no tangle, good layer adhesion, easy to use.

  • Super Neat Filament Spool, Spool Diameter: 8.00", Spool Width: 2.50", Spool Hub Hole Diameter: 2.20". The size of the SUNLU filament spool is suitable for hanging on a lot of FDM 3D printers.
  • 1.75mm Filament Diameter, Dimensional Accuracy +/- 0.02mm. SUNLU filament has wide compatibility due to the small diameter error, it's suitable for almost all 1.75mm FDM 3D printers.
  • Recommend Settings:
    Printing temperature 250-260℃ at print speed 50-100mm/s,
    Printing temperature 260-280℃ at print speed 100-200mm/s
    Plate Temperature: 90-110 ℃
  • UV/Rain/Heat Resistant, SUNLU ASA 3D printing filament is great for printing outdoor functional mechanical parts, UV/Rain/Heat highly resistant.
  • SUNLU Professional Team, SUNLU is a high-tech enterprise specializing in R&D, production and sales of 3D filament, 3D printer, 3D pen, filament dryer, 3D resin and resin UV light curing box.
  • Diameter: 1.75/3.0MM±0.02MM
    Net weight: 1 KG/roll, 0.9kg/roll
    Length: 1.75MM(1KG)=395M

 

#SUNLU ASA Filament 1.75mm, #UV/Rain/Heat Resistant Tough 3D Printer Filament, #Great for Printing Outdoor Functional Mechanical Parts, #1kg Spool (2.2lbs)

title: SUNLU Matte PLA 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[Fantastic & Smooth Matte Finish] The SUNLU PLA matte filament finish is great and really helps to hide layer lines,bringing out other details of the print Prints smooth and has a beautiful matte finish.SUNLU nice PLA matte filament is achieved without compromising bed and layer adhesion, which results in beautiful and fairly strong PLA filament parts.Almost metallic finish and soft smooth finish.

[Neatly Wound Filament & No Odour] SUNLU has a professional production line with strict control of neatly lined up lines to avoid knots during printing.Completely mechanical wire winding and strict manual checks to ensure neat lines with few kinks, avoiding possible breaks.SUNLU PLA Matte filament is a biological material, purified from corn grain, eco-friendly, odourless and harmless to humans.

[High Precision +/- 0.02mm Tolerance PLA Matte filament] 1.75mm PLA Matte 3D filament(Tolerance Level : ± 0.02mm).1KG 3d printer filament reel,perfect roundness and very tight diameter tolerance,approximately 330m of PLA Matte filament on each spool ease of use,minimal warping,no clogging,no bubbles.Increase your 3d printing objects delicacy.

[High Fluidity, Less Stringing, Strong Layer Adhesion] Better flow of SUNLU no plugging premium 1.75mm PLA Matte filament. It has consistent diameter; roundness, less stringing and warping,strong layer adhesion. Article-free and impurity-free. No impurities, no clogged. Recommended PLA Matte Filament Extrusion/Nozzle Temperature 205-215℃(at print speed 50 -100mm/s), 215-245℃(at print speed 100-230mm/s)

[High Compatiblity & Vacuum Pack PLA Matte Filament] Compatible with 99% FDM 3D printers (with heated beds) and 3D pen.Vacuum packed neatly arranged SUNLU PLA Matte filament, provide better printing result.Environmental protection,1KG PLA Matte filament is made from starch raw materials derived from renewable plant resources.

title: SUNLU PETG 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[Excellent Layer Adhesion] PETG filament offers excellent layer adhesion, reducing the risks of warping and ensuring smooth, strong prints with great structural integrity.

[Enhanced Toughness] Known for its toughness, PETG outperforms many other filaments in durability, making it ideal for creating sturdy and resilient items that can withstand stress and use.

[High Impact Strength] With its high impact resistance, PETG is perfect for printing parts that need to endure bumps and drops, ensuring long-lasting performance without cracks or breaks.

[Robust Durability] PETG prints are robust and maintain their properties over time, making them suitable for both indoor and outdoor applications where weather resistance is a necessity.

[Less Stringing & No Blocking] SUNLU PETG filament is specially engineered to reduce stringiness and eliminate clogging, ensuring a smooth and consistent print every time.

[PETG Recommend Settings] We recommend printing the PETG filament at:
230-240℃ at print speed 50 -100mm/s 
240-260℃ at print speed 100-200mm/s

title: SUNLU SILK PLA Plus (SILK PLA+) 3D Printer Filament 1KG
body_html:
[SUNLU Shiny SILK PLA+ Filament] SUNLU SILK PLA PLUS filament offers a stunning, glossy finish that outshines standard PLA PLUS. Its smooth, silky surface requires no post-print polishing, making it perfect for artistic and craft projects. This filament adds a luxurious sheen to any 3D print, elevating your creations with a brilliant silk-like appearance.

[Effortless Printing Experience] Enjoy seamless printing with SUNLU SILK PLA PLUS filament, designed to feed smoothly without clogging or jamming. With a precise diameter of 1.75mm (tolerance: ± 0.02mm) and a 1kg spool (2.2 lbs), this filament ensures consistent, warp-free prints. Say goodbye to nozzle clogs and achieve fast, reliable results every time.

[Optimal Print Settings] SUNLU SILK PLA PLUS filament is engineered for easy 3D printing with optimal quality. Featuring high purity, low shrinkage, and excellent interlayer adhesion, it delivers superior performance. Recommended printing temperatures are 205-215℃ at 50-100mm/s, and 215-235℃ at 100-200mm/s, with a heated bed temperature of 50-60°C.

[Perfectly Wound Filament] SUNLU's professional production process ensures neatly wound filament, minimizing the risk of tangling during prints. Each spool undergoes both mechanical winding and meticulous manual inspection to guarantee smooth, uninterrupted printing with minimal knots.

[Vacuum Sealed for Quality] SUNLU SILK filament is vacuum-sealed with a desiccant to keep it free from dust and moisture. This packaging ensures a bubble-free, low-shrinkage, and low-warping experience, protecting the filament and maintaining its quality for flawless prints.

body_html:
[SUNLU Standard Resin] SUNLU Standard Resin cures rapidly upon exposure to 395-405nm UV light emitted by a resin printer(or resin curing machine). It is suitable for use with most 2K/4K/6K/8K resin 3D printers (LCD/DLP/SLA), delivering efficient and reliable results.

[Low Shrinkage and High Precision 3D Resin] SUNLU Resin R&D team focuses on reducing volume shrinkage during the curing process to guarantee exceptional precision and stable performance. Experience outstanding print quality, enhanced accuracy, and reliable stability with SUNLU's low-shrinkage resin formula.

[High Compatibility and Easy to Use] SUNLU have extensively tested and optimized the performance of our resin on various printer brands, ensuring exceptional compatibility and ease of use. Whether you're a beginner or an experienced user, SUNLU resin offers a seamless printing experience with excellent results.

[Easy to Clean and Less Odor Resin] SUNLU Standard Resin offers effortless cleaning with isopropyl alcohol or ethanol, resulting in a smooth surface finish. Theodor during the 3D printing is light.

[Various Colors for Printing] SUNLU Standard Resin offers an extensive range of colors, including solid color, clear color, and macaron colors. SUNLU makes your imagination come ture, and bring your designs to life with our vibrant and expansive color selection.

title: SUNLU S2 Filament Dryer, 360° Surround Heating During 3D Printing
body_html:
[Keep Filaments Strong & Flexible] By Using SUNLU Filament Dryer Box S2 to removing moisture from the filament before it's used in the 3D printer, S2 filament dryer helps to ensure that the filament will be dryed. which will result in better print quality and fewer failed prints. This is important in save time, money, and frustration by improving the reliability and consistency of their 3D printing process.
[Touch Screen & Easy Operation] 3D filament dry box S2 has a new touch screen that is designed to provide a tablet-like operation experience for the user. The screen is 3.42*2.87 inches in size, which makes it easy to navigate and use. The touch screen also allows user to easily switch between ℃ and ℉ and offers one-key recommended temperature settings for different types of filament. This makes it easy for the user to set the appropriate drying temperature for their filament.
[Easy to Use & Quality Guaranteed] Allows you to print while drying. 2 inch large LCD screen monitor,Able to display temperature&time clearly and brightly. Decrease Noise when Printing (less than 10db while operating).
[Wide Compatibility Range] compatible with a wide range of filament brands and diameters. It can work with all mainstream 3D filament brands and all standard filament diameters of 1.75mm/2.85mm/3.00mm. This means that it can be used with a variety of filaments, including PLA, PLA+, PETG, TPU, ABS, and even high-end filaments like PA and PC. This makes it a versatile and convenient option for users who want to dry their filament.
[Drying & Printing at One Time] The feed-out coil also allows the filament to continue to dry in the dryer as it's being fed to the printer. This means that the filament will be dry and ready to use when it reaches the printer.
